window: 4 AM Wed 4 Nov to 4 AM Thu 5 Nov IST
headline: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana led yesterday with 373K tickets booked, while Scene rose up 171% to 240K.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana was rank 1 with 373K tickets booked, up 134% on the day before and up 1266% on a week ago.
Scene and Scene (Telugu) were close behind at 240K each, both up 171% on the day before, with Scene the biggest mover.
Jailer 2 (31.5K) and Aadarsha Kutumbam (23.9K) were the next largest, both down on the day before.
Interest is led by Namit Malhotra's Ramayana at 617K+, which gained +27K in 24 hours and opens Thu 5 Nov.
Avengers: Doomsday has 494K+ interested, gained +6K in 24 hours, and bookings are not open yet.
